summary: Root cause: prose sleep ignored because LLM has no timer -> answers+finishes. Fix: mandatory single read-only shell command whose duration is wall-clock-bounded (timeout 115 sh -c while SECONDS<end pwd>/dev/null; sleep 5; done), single-action imperative contract (no answer/other cmd/files/delegate). Read-only, observably active, self-terminating+hard-capped. Cleanup: in-command timeout self-exit (124=benign) + harness cancel sweep at CANCEL_AT over all task_ids (idempotent-safe, benign classification). Barrier: 110s hold >> submit/startup spread -> all 20 overlap; optional wait-until-running for deterministic window. Hold MUST be < confirmed platform task running-timeout (verify owner) -> flagged blocker. Execution gated (live run).
validation: design-only, no execution, no probe, no edits (git diff --check CLEAN). Builds on documented /tmp/t20_workload.py.
